entries.title: Narrator: "The National Mausoleum, high in the..."
entries.dialogueText: The National Mausoleum, high in the hills above Porte Drazon, embraced me with its stately presence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here for the annual Sovereign..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here for the annual Sovereign Memorial Commemoration, a ceremony honoring the former monarchs of Rizia, held just outside the mausoleum's entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hushed corridors were adorned w..."
entries.dialogueText: The hushed corridors were adorned with statues and inscriptions of monarchs from eras long past.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The mausoleum stood as a witness to..."
entries.dialogueText: The mausoleum stood as a witness to the enduring legacy of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had also come to honor the memory..."
entries.dialogueText: I had also come to honor the memory of my late wife, Lena, whose resting place could be found within these hallowed grounds as well.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adjacent to it stood a bouquet of r..."
entries.dialogueText: Adjacent to it stood a bouquet of recently placed flowers, a weekly tradition per Vina's instructions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Take a flower."
entries.dialogueText: Take a flower.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Leave the flowers as is."
entries.dialogueText: Leave the flowers as is.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a flower from the bouquet an..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a flower from the bouquet and smelled it. The scent of roses still reminded me of her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I stood in contemplation, reflec..."
entries.dialogueText: As I stood in contemplation, reflecting upon our time together, a gentle voice called from behind.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Romus...”"
entries.dialogueText: “Romus...”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Mother? This is a surprise.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mother? This is a surprise.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hadn’t attended a Sovereign Mem..."
entries.dialogueText: She hadn’t attended a Sovereign Memorial Commemoration since Father’s passing.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“At my age, surprises are as rare a..."
entries.dialogueText: “At my age, surprises are as rare as non-gray hairs. Don't act as though my presence is some extraordinary revelation.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“And, for the record, I can still n..."
entries.dialogueText: “And, for the record, I can still navigate these halls without assistance--”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes swept across the room, com..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes swept across the room, coming to rest on Lena's grave.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Forgive my lack of decorum. I shou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Forgive my lack of decorum. I should treat this day with the gravity it deserves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gradually, she drew near, her eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: Gradually, she drew near, her eyes conveying unexpressed sentiment.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“You of all people know what an ext..."
entries.dialogueText: “You of all people know what an extraordinary woman she was. Though I confess it took me a while to warm up to her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“What was extraordinary about her?..."
entries.dialogueText: “What was extraordinary about her? She was just another entitled noblewoman."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“That's what I thought as well, dar..."
entries.dialogueText: “That's what I thought as well, darling. At first."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“I remember the exact moment my fee..."
entries.dialogueText: “I remember the exact moment my feelings toward Princess Lena changed.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“It was right after the civil war b..."
entries.dialogueText: “It was right after the civil war broke out in Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Up to that point, I was adamant th..."
entries.dialogueText: “Up to that point, I was adamant that Rizia should accept as few Wehzek refugees as possible."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The next day, I persuaded Valero t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next day, I persuaded Valero to open our borders."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother reached into her handbag..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother reached into her handbag and held up a weathered envelope.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took the envelope from her."
entries.dialogueText: I took the envelope from her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn’t take the envelope."
entries.dialogueText: I didn’t take the envelope.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“A love letter from your father --..."
entries.dialogueText: “A love letter from your father -- the first one he ever wrote. I want to honor him by giving it back.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Quite the keepsake.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Quite the keepsake.”

entries.dialogueText: "I didn't know you felt that way about her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We made our way down the great hall..."
entries.dialogueText: We made our way down the great hall, past the resting places of the great leaders, and some not-so-great, who came before me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn’t long before the light fro..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn’t long before the light from the Eternal Flame, a single torch placed at the late king’s sarcophagus symbolizing a monarch’s enduring reign, guided us the rest of the way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we neared, my mother’s pace slow..."
entries.dialogueText: As we neared, my mother’s pace slowed as if waves of memories pressed upon her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The flame's flickering glow cast da..."
entries.dialogueText: The flame's flickering glow cast dancing shadows on our path.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stopped just before we reached m..."
entries.dialogueText: We stopped just before we reached my father’s stone encasing.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“There you are...”"
entries.dialogueText: “There you are...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We both fell silent."
entries.dialogueText: We both fell silent.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“If you don’t mind, I’d like to say..."
entries.dialogueText: “If you don’t mind, I’d like to say a few words to your father.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Please, by all means.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Please, by all means.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Val... For 45 years, we walked dif..."
entries.dialogueText: “Val... For 45 years, we walked different paths, our views often conflicting, and our words sometimes harsh."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But the love between us never wane..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the love between us never waned."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""So, in this space between the livi..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, in this space between the living and the departed, I speak these final words. My reserved heart lays bare the truth..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She presented the letter to the fla..."
entries.dialogueText: She presented the letter to the flame, watching as it intensified, consuming the paper until it vanished.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“May he rest in peace as his legacy..."
entries.dialogueText: “May he rest in peace as his legacy lives on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Legacy... I doubt history will be..."
entries.dialogueText: “Legacy... I doubt history will be very kind.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“I’m not speaking of his actions on..."
entries.dialogueText: “I’m not speaking of his actions on the throne. His legacy is you.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“A heavy burden to bear -- a name f..."
entries.dialogueText: “A heavy burden to bear -- a name forever stained by the judgments of time.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Legacies are shaped by more than j..."
entries.dialogueText: “Legacies are shaped by more than just deeds. What you make of the name matters just as much.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I can't escape the shadows of his..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can't escape the shadows of his choices, no matter what path I forge.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Maybe not, but you can cast new sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not, but you can cast new shadows that speak of redemption and resilience."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Sometimes, the most profound respo..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sometimes, the most profound responsibilities are the ones we inherit, not by choice, but by destiny.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Destiny or not, I'll strive to lea..."
entries.dialogueText: “Destiny or not, I'll strive to leave a legacy that stands apart from the mistakes of my father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“My triumph over Pales will rectify..."
entries.dialogueText: “My triumph over Pales will rectify his failure.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“Or be your undoing, just like him...."
entries.dialogueText: “Or be your undoing, just like him. His relentless pursuit of victory at any cost consumed him, as I fear it may be consuming you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I began pacing around the hall."
entries.dialogueText: I began pacing around the hall.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“You know nothing.”"
entries.dialogueText: “You know nothing.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“So sure of yourself. I'll tell you..."
entries.dialogueText: “So sure of yourself. I'll tell you what I do know... ”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“I know that my son is determined t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know that my son is determined to embark on some military expedition when his attention should be focused on the rightful restoration of Zille.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: "“I know that the very foundations o..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know that the very foundations of the monarchy have been put at risk through such actions.”

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""And speaking of risk... I've heard..."
entries.dialogueText: "And speaking of risk... I've heard whispers about your *escapades* with House Azaro, a family harboring their own ambitions regarding the throne."

entries.dialogueText: "If you insist, but please make it brief. I don't have all day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I find comfort in knowing that his legacy lives on, but it doesn't change the pain of his absence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, my father's and my legacies are intertwined."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reminder to choose our path with..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reminder to choose our path with care."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What matters is what I do, not wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "What matters is what I do, not what the name did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll ensure the name stands strong..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll ensure the name stands strong, even if it means shouldering the weight alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My actions speak louder than any f..."
entries.dialogueText: "My actions speak louder than any family name. I'll forge my path."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed, like divine threads in a g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, like divine threads in a grand design, guiding us toward a purpose beyond our choosing, much like Father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Father's path proved it's the choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father's path proved it's the choices, not fate, that shape our destiny."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll embrace whatever responsibili..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll embrace whatever responsibilities destiny throws at me, be it triumphs or defeats, much like my father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My victory over Pales will honor h..."
entries.dialogueText: "My victory over Pales will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God willing, my victory over Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "God willing, my victory over Pales will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your concern, but thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your concern, but this time will be different. God is on our side. I can feel it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't see into the future any..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't see into the future any more than anyone else."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Farewell, until we meet where love..."
entries.dialogueText: "Farewell, until we meet where love knows no bounds."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The years may have etched lines on..."
entries.dialogueText: "The years may have etched lines on our faces, but they also deepened my affection for you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My heart bears no bitterness. Inst..."
entries.dialogueText: "My heart bears no bitterness. Instead, it carries the memories of laughter, shared moments, and a touch beyond words."
